question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing cheerleader, Bob is playing right midfielder, Claire is playing fullback, Dave is playing right back, Eve is playing right winger, Fred is playing striker, and Gertrude is playing benchwarmer.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Fred and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Alice trade positions. Then, Fred and Bob trade positions. Then, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Fred and Bob trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Alice trade positions. Finally, Fred and Dave trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) cheerleader
(B) right midfielder
(C) fullback
(D) right back
(E) right winger
(F) striker
(G) benchwarmer
solution:
Position order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: cheerleader, right midfielder, fullback, right back, right winger, striker, benchwarmer.
1. Fred ↔ Gertrude: cheerleader, right midfielder, fullback, right back, right winger, benchwarmer, striker.
2. Gertrude ↔ Alice: striker, right midfielder, fullback, right back, right winger, benchwarmer, cheerleader.
3. Fred ↔ Bob: striker, benchwarmer, fullback, right back, right winger, right midfielder, cheerleader.
4. Bob ↔ Gertrude: striker, cheerleader, fullback, right back, right winger, right midfielder, benchwarmer.
5. Fred ↔ Bob: striker, right midfielder, fullback, right back, right winger, cheerleader, benchwarmer.
6. Gertrude ↔ Alice: benchwarmer, right midfielder, fullback, right back, right winger, cheerleader, striker.
7. Fred ↔ Dave: benchwarmer, right midfielder, fullback, cheerleader, right winger, right back, striker.
Alice is the benchwarmer, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
